trap.label: tempo verbal
trap.wrong: Last year I check it every hour.
trap.right: Last year I checked it every hour.
trap.why: Com marcador de passado (last year) o inglês exige passado; o brasileiro às vezes mantém o presente, como no “eu checo” informal.

mcq.q: Last year I **___** the news every hour.
I decided **___** the news twice a day.

fix.wrong: I decided reading it twice a day.
fix.right: I decided to read it twice a day.

fix.wrong: Now I am feeling calm every day.
fix.right: Now I feel calm every day.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para o passado: “I check the news hourly.”
Use decided to: “I read it twice.” (I decided…)
rewrite.answer: I decided to read it twice.
